name: magnolia-cargo-utils
description: Utilities for managing Magnolia Cargo server

scripts.start: run-s start-timer check-server && run-p clean:locks clean:cargo clean:logs && run-s build && run-p maildev start:cargo monitor
scripts.start:noclean: cross-env CLEAR_LOGS=false run-s start-timer check-server clean:locks clean:cargo build && run-p maildev start:cargo monitor
scripts.start:nomail: cross-env MAILDEV_ENABLED=false run-s start-timer check-server clean:locks clean:cargo clean:logs build && run-p start:cargo monitor
scripts.start:author: cross-env MAGNOLIA_INSTANCE_MODE=author npm start
